literal: Good deed forgetting good is not; good that which is not that very day forgetting is good.
translation: It is not good to forget a good deed. It is good to forget a bad deed that very day.
modern: ஒருவர் செய்த நன்மையை மறப்பது நல்லதல்ல; அவர் செய்த தீமையை நடந்த அன்றே மறந்துவிடுவது நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet contrasts how one should handle good and bad deeds done by others. The word 'நன்றி' refers to a benefit or help received, which should never be forgotten. Conversely, 'நன்று அல்லது' (that which is not good) refers to a wrong or injury suffered. The couplet advises that while gratitude must be permanent, any resentment for a bad deed should be discarded 'அன்றே' (on that very day) to maintain one's own peace and virtue.
